newsitem.title: USA: Geo Petroleum reserves increased in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Geo Petroleum reserves increased in 1996.

text.p: GEO Petroleum Inc said Wednesday its proven reserves of oil rose to 33 million barrels in 1996, representing an increase of 2.6 million barrels, or 8.5 percent, from 1995.
During 1996, future net revenues rose 70 percent to $341 million, representing a gain of $140 million.

The present value of the proven reserves, discounted at 10 percent per annum in accordance with guidelines of the Securities and Exchange Commission, is $165 million, an 86 percent increase ($76 million) from 1995.
